headlines.text: Turning the clock back to 2023: Adam Cole vs. MJF met in an Eliminator Match, setting the tone as the night's opener on Dynamite, rated 8.59 ? an outstanding performance from both sides.
Rewind to 2024, when PAC vs. Jay Lethal headlined Rampage, rated 6.34.

Flash back to 2023, when Matt Jackson chalked up their 100th recorded AEW match ? a hundred-plus matches deep into their AEW career, facing Young Bucks & Page vs. Castagnoli, Moxley & Yuta, topping the bill that night on Dynamite, rated 8.06 ? an excellent showing in a fast-paced six-man clash.

secondaries.text: Flash back to 2023, when the AEW Women's World Title was up for grabs as Toni Storm vs. Skye Blue went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.82.
Back on this day in 2023, Allin & Sting vs. Gates of Agony locked horns for the first time on Dynamite, rated 6.69.
It was 2023 when Wardlow vs. Jake Hager went to battle over the AEW TNT Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 4.55.
